source.status: PRELIMINARY — supplied figure image, reproduced for reference. No value is derived from it anywhere in this repository; the published standard governs for issued design.
source.note: A filing record for a supplied figure image. The image is the artefact; this document records where it sits, what the standard captions it, and the sha256 of its bytes. NOTHING PARSES A FIGURE: a curve carries no text, so the only route from an image to a number is reading one off by eye, which database/CLAUDE.md forbids. This record exists so a figure can be cited and so a change to one is caught, never so a value can be taken from it.
